bio: Bannatyne Humberston is a contemporary leisure destination and day spa. Surrounded by a nine hole golf course and four outdoor tennis courts, it also has a modern gym, pool, sauna and steam room inside.  Afternoon Tea is served in the restaurant, lounge or outdoor area which is a peaceful oasis of calm providing diners with the ideal environment to unwind while enjoying the great British tradition in picturesque surroundings overlooking a 9 hole golf course.  The Afternoon Tea menu consists of quintessential features of the British ritual such as sandwiches, scones and cakes. Those feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of prosecco or a refreshing peach Bellini.  Afternoon Tea is served everyday and costs £10 per person or £15 with a Bottega Gold Prosecco Brut.
